encoding.leaf: keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(kilnId, season, status, pZigzagBp, evidenceHash)))) (OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree, sorted leaves, commutative pair hash)
encoding.kiln_id: ethers encodeBytes32String(id): UTF-8 bytes, right-padded with zeros to 32, max 31 bytes
encoding.evidence_hash: 0x + sha256(utf8(canonical JSON of {scene_id, date, probs, set, chip_sha256, model_sha256})); keys sorted at every depth; separators ',' and ':' with no whitespace; strings as JSON with non-ASCII left unescaped
encoding.probs: each probability = round(p, 4) with round-half-even on the exact double (Python round(float(p), 4)); written as the shortest round-trip number; integral values have no decimal point (1, 0); null when the kiln has no probabilities
encoding.set: array of class names sorted ascending
encoding.chip_sha256: lowercase hex sha256 of the chip PNG bytes, or the string 'none' if the file is missing
encoding.model_sha256: lowercase hex from summary.json model_sha256, or 'none'
encoding.p_zigzag_bp: the quantised zigzag probability times 10000 (an exact integer), 0 when probs is null
